description: Live check of any contract on Ethereum or Base before you interact with it: is it an upgradeable proxy (EIP-1967, beacon, ZeppelinOS), its current implementation, and whether upgrades and owner() are controlled by a single key, a Safe multisig (m-of-n) or a timelock. Adds the upgrade history when the contract is one this feed watches. Costs $0.005 (x402, USDC).

address.description: Contract address, 0x followed by 40 hex characters

name: contract_check
